climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A US wine state, the second-largest grape-growing state by volume after California. Most of its vineyard area is American Vitis labrusca grapes, mainly Concord, and the rest is split between vinifera and French hybrids. Its AVAs include the Finger Lakes and Long Island.
